description: Restored to static display and now finished and in the hangar per the squadron's own project page which credits Hank Bowers John Carr and Dan Weber; the squadron describes it as a Folland Gnat or HAL Ajeet used in the India-Pakistan wars; one directory gives the serial as E276 but that is a single undated entry from a source that demonstrably shuffles rows at other museums so the tail number is left blank rather than assert a serial that cannot be corroborated

Wears the markings 298730 with code 6C-D; 42-98730 is a valid L-5 serial in the block 42-98066 to 42-99163 which is why the marking is read as an abbreviated serial rather than a random number; both a directory and the FAA call it an L-5E but L-5E serials are in the 44-17xxx range and cannot be 42-98730 so the variant field is left blank; privately owned with the FAA showing N2561C registered to Ramiro Gonzalez of Lancaster Ohio
